entries.01c166facdd488d9: The holding company of a group that undertakes construction work on roads, bridges, buildings and more, and also operates power plants and public infrastructure.
entries.02f3d9251dc4bb7d: This business consists of construction work, including paving work, and mainly the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixtures. Maeda Road Construction Co., Ltd., Mitsui Jūken Dōro Co., Ltd. and others conduct this business and order part of the construction work they undertake, as well as materials supply, to affiliated companies. Mitsui Jūken Dōro Co., Ltd. files securities reports and is a consolidated subsidiary, of which the company holds 53.7% of voting rights through indirect ownership. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥282,240 million (¥263,101 million in the previous fiscal year, a 7.3% increase), the second largest after the Building Business. Revenue remained firm, and the results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 include those of Mitsui Jūken Dōro Co., Ltd. after it became a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.330beea1b6f401c1: A business engaged in the manufacture, sale and rental of construction machinery. Maeda Seisakusho Co., Ltd., based in Nagano City, Nagano Prefecture (a consolidated subsidiary in which the company holds 100.0% of voting rights), and others conduct this business and sell or lease some construction machinery to affiliated companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,501 million (¥41,018 million in the previous fiscal year, a 3.7% decrease), the fourth largest. Sales of construction-machinery-related products were firm, but sales of in-house products such as cranes stagnated, which was the reason for the decline in revenue.

entries.8964ba0ac7272102: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, consisting of various businesses conducted by some subsidiaries.

entries.9f5323d0f408182f: A business that not only undertakes construction work but also operates power plants and public infrastructure itself.
entries.a6c253a67c1beb93: This business consists of construction work centered on housing complexes and factories and logistics facilities, and related businesses. Maeda Corporation, Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co., Ltd. and others conduct this business and order part of the construction work they undertake, as well as materials supply, to affiliated companies. This segment also includes JM Co., Ltd. and FBS Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥497,727 million (¥363,448 million in the previous fiscal year, a 36.9% increase), the largest of the five reportable segments. The increase in revenue was due to steady progress in domestic building construction work on hand, including large-scale projects such as urban redevelopment, and the results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 include those of Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co., Ltd. after it became a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.a8ecf010dac6b97b: This business acquires operating rights for public infrastructure and undertakes construction, operation and maintenance. Subsidiary Aichi Road Concession Co., Ltd. (50.0% of voting rights) operates and maintains roads, Miotsukushi Kōgyō Yōsui Concession Co., Ltd. (71.0%) operates and maintains industrial water, and affiliate Sendai International Airport Co., Ltd. (30.0%) operates and maintains the airport.
entries.c1e4ddab86041cb3: Operation and maintenance of public infrastructure for which operating rights have been acquired
entries.d56498ac3cf02fe2: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, consisting of various businesses conducted by some subsidiaries. These include the hotel business, software development business, sale of construction materials and real estate business, among others; J-City Co., Ltd. operates the hotel business, and Realtech Co., Ltd. operates the software development business. Affiliate Hikarigaoka Kōsan Co., Ltd. (23.8% of voting rights) conducts the real estate business, mainly through the sale of construction materials and the leasing and sale of land and buildings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,035 million (¥2,846 million in the previous fiscal year), a small segment relative to the consolidated total.
entries.d740c04540bfc4c6: A business that not only undertakes construction work but also operates power plants and public infrastructure itself. It mainly operates two businesses: renewable energy and concessions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥37,417 million (¥30,777 million in the previous fiscal year, a 21.6% increase), the smallest of the five reportable segments. The increase in revenue was due to the full-year operation of Ozu Biomass Power Co., Ltd. and real estate sales at the Komono Villa Project (tokumei kumiai), among others. Subsidiary Maeda Corporation and others have received construction orders for these businesses.

entries.f6b072b6f4c56e6b: This business consists of construction work centered on bridges and tunnels, and related businesses. Maeda Corporation, Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co., Ltd. and others conduct this business and order part of the construction work they undertake, as well as materials supply, to affiliated companies. This segment also includes Fujimi Kōken Co., Ltd., Mitsui Sumitomo Kensetsu Tekkō Enjiniaringu Co., Ltd. and Dōpī Kensetsu Kōgyō Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥264,954 million (¥146,357 million in the previous fiscal year, an 81.0% increase), the third largest. Revenue increased mainly because work on hand at the beginning of the period and progress on work ordered in the current period were steady in domestic civil engineering work, and the results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 include those of Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co., Ltd. after it became a consolidated subsidiary.
